3) Burst profile: spikes generally happen during marketing campaigns and a few daily peak times. Expect ~10–12 campaign spikes a month (each 10–30 minutes) and daily peak windows that are ~5–10 minutes at lower RPS.

Marissa — attaching a short proposal and the pricing model CSV. Summary below so Sam gets a quick answer in the morning: 

Proposed commercial (budgetary):
- Committed tier A: 50M tokens/month = $26 per 1M tokens => $1,300/month effective unit pricing shown as $1,300 for 50M (we'll show clear math in the PDF).
- Committed tier B: 70M tokens/month = $22 per 1M tokens => $1,540/month (unit pricing scales to $22/1M).
- Embeddings: bundled at $0.70 per 1k vectors with a 10% discount if packaged with committed tokens.

Burst and overage rules (operational proposal):
- Soft-burst buffer: automatic allowance up to 2x committed throughput for any single 15-minute window, capped to 10% of monthly committed tokens as billable burst allowance (to prevent abuse).
- Overage billing: any usage beyond committed + burst buffer billed at 1.2x the committed unit price (i.e., 20% premium). Example: for tier B ($22/1M), overage = $26.40 per 1M tokens.
- Hard quota / throttling: if usage exceeds committed + burst buffer + a safety cap (25% of committed) within a 24-hour rolling window, requests will be soft-throttled and we’ll notify the engineering on-call.
- Quota increases: guaranteed capacity increase for planned changes with >=48 hours notice (we can provision extra reserved capacity). For urgent / ad-hoc increases we’ll do best-effort within 4–12 hours based on capacity availability; guaranteed SLA requires paid short-term burst reservation.

Operational notes: we recommend they commit at least 50M for the initial rollout to hit $/1M economics near their $25 target. If they anticipate frequent >2x spikes, we can offer a paid burst reservation add-on that guarantees 2x sustained capacity for the campaign window (priced as a % of committed spend).

Attachments: pricing_proposal_acme_v2.pdf, pricing_model_acme.csv

Let me know if you'd like me to lower the tier A price to meet the $25/1M target (we can do $25/1M at 50M with a one-quarter commitment and a slightly longer invoice term).

Thanks — Dylan
